mapper.select:
select c.id, c.type, c.name, c.sort, c.status, c.create_time, c.update_time, c.create_user, c.update_user, (select count(*) from dish where category_id = c.id) as dish_count, (select count(*) from setmeal where category_id = c.id) as setmeal_count from category c
and c.name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
and c.type = #{type}
order by c.sort desc
